name: curlie
description: Modern curl frontend with HTTPie-inspired syntax and curl's power - colorful output with simplified header syntax and real-time streaming

curlie.description: Modern curl frontend combining curl's power with HTTPie's ease of use - supports all curl features with syntax highlighting and intuitive header syntax
curlie.usage:
curlie GET httpbin.org/json # Simple GET request
curlie POST httpbin.org/post name=John age:=25 # JSON POST with HTTPie syntax
curlie -L httpbin.org/redirect/3 # Follow redirects like curl
curlie --data '{"key":"value"}' -H Content-Type:application/json POST api.com/data # Raw JSON with headers
